subject: can INLA fit repeated survey data and changing covariates?

messages.author: e4d74220beb7c72f
messages.subject: can INLA fit repeated survey data and changing covariates?
parts:
I have a data set with abundance data surveys at the same location over the years, and I want to use INLA to predict abundance. However each location has different survey effort. Will INLA be able to handle this type of data structure, with repeated surveys and changing environmental covariates with each survey?

Thanks for any feedback!
